description: Wondershare EdrawMax is open and showing its Home screen. The left sidebar shows tool icons (Symbols, Text, Images, etc.) and the canvas center shows a 'Create New' card with a + icon. Click the 'Create New' card in the center of the canvas, then select 'Org Chart' from the diagram type categories that appear. If a blue notification banner ('Click here to view more temporarily saved files') is visible at the top, click its 'Got it' button to dismiss it before proceeding. Create an org chart based on the publicly documented Apache Software Foundation governance structure: Top level box: 'Board of Directors'. Second level (3 boxes): 'President', 'Executive Vice President', 'Secretary'. Third level under President: 'VP Infrastructure', 'VP Legal Affairs', 'VP Marketing'. Connect all boxes with hierarchy lines showing the reporting relationships. When done, save the file as 'apache_org_chart.eddx' in /home/ga/ using File > Save As.
